legacy_root.title: Numeric floor deficit audit with a published counting rule and a planted-duplicate control
legacy_root.question: Question: for every 'at least N' in the spec, what is the measured count and the deficit? The floors are 2,048 work units; 160 workflow candidates/mechanisms; 96 blueprints of which 40 flagship; 48 council protocols; 64 editable presets; 9 architectures; and the 100-unique-idea brainstorm target. For each, publish the exact counting rule (regex or JSON path), the measured number, the deficit, and a detector control proving the counter finds a known-present item and is SILENT on a planted near-duplicate.
legacy_root.scope_boundary: CC-0024 extracts floor STATEMENTS. CNF-0188 recounts them. This unit contributes the COUNTED deficit plus the anti-padding control: a renamed or near-duplicate entry does not increment a floor. 07-OPTION-UNIVERSE, 08-WORKFLOW-ARCHAEOLOGY, 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY, 12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS, and PROMPT-ONE-FLOOR-AUDIT.json are ABSENT on this worktree; those floors measure 0 from disk, not from catalog hearsay (R-A08 108 blueprints / R-A09 58 protocols + 72 presets).

live_sources.note: Catalog R-A08/R-A09 numbers are CLAIMS recorded in WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json items, not this unit's measurement. Taking them as counts would be single-signal restatement.

floors.counting_rule_md_or_text: Markdown #### ids under ## Architectures, else same DESIGN.json files via text search

floors.counting_rule_json: JSON path $.ideas[*]; unique body fingerprints (reworded copies collapse)
floors.counting_rule_md_or_text: Markdown #### ids under ## Ideas; unique body fingerprints

md_json_set_identity.rule: The two SETS must be identical, not merely equal in size.

disjointness.proof: protocols (8) and presets (10) are two disjoint fields; 8+10 equals the council file's total h4 heading count of 18. max() would be 10, which proves nothing about double-counting.
